newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bompreco plans IPO in November.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bompreco plans IPO in November.

text.p: Brazilian supermarket chain Bompreco will launch an initial public offering of $100 million on international and domestic markets in early November, a bank official said.

The offer will total 10 million preferred shares with prices ranging between $8.41 and $10, said Francisco Lima, manager of Bradesco's capital market department, which is co-ordinating the operation with U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers.

Roughly 50 percent of the 10 million shares, which account for 22 percent of Bompreco's total capital, will be sold in the domestic market and the other half will be sold in the United States and Europe, Lima said.
Proceeds from the issue will be used to finance the firm's modernization and expansion plans, he added.
Bompreco, which has a strong presence in Brazil's Northeast, is the country's fourth largest supermarket chain. It is controlled by Paes Medonca family.
